title: Discovery and Mechanistic Investigation of a Bacteria-Derived Sesquiterpene Ether Synthase AceS Catalyzing Syn-Protoetherification.
authors: Liu, Yuanning; Zhang, Shouqi; Zou, Jiasheng; Xu, Wenqiang; Wang, Tao; Wang, Chen; Kong, Yao; Zhang, Pengcheng; Wang, Kaibiao; Hsiao, Po-Yun; Jia, Hongli; Liu, Fen; Yin, Min; Chang, Chin-Yuan; Xu, Zhengren
journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
one_liner_zh: 该文研究细菌倍半萜合酶AceS催化syn-protoetherification的机理，结合DFT计算、蛋白结构指导突变和分子对接模拟，虽以酶催化机理为核心，但涉及蛋白结构计算建模，可为本课题提供酶结构-功能关系与对接方法参考。
abstract: To discharge the carbocation in the termination step of terpene synthase (TS)-catalyzed cyclization, in addition to proton elimination to form alkene products and water quenching to afford hydroxylated products, intramolecular hydroxy group-trapping to give terpene ethers represents a variation of the latter case. Among the limited known TSs that are able to directly convert the linear oligoprenyl diphosphates to terpene ethers, 1,8-cineole synthase is the only characterized enzyme that catalyzes syn-protoetherification of the double bond in the termination step. We herein report the discovery and mechanistic investigation of a bacteria-derived sesquiterpene synthase AceS, converting farnesyl diphosphate to acorenol ether (1) in a syn-protoetherification manner. The unique 5/6 spiro-fused acorane skeleton with an ether ring bridging C3 and C7 of 1 was elucidated based on NMR analysis and X-ray diffraction (XRD) of a cytochrome P450-modified derivative. Labeling experiments using our recently developed "deuterium-scanning" approach allowed us to characterize a 1,2-hydride shift from C10 to C11 and a hydride shift from C6 to C10, as well as the syn-stereochemistry of the protoetherification process during cyclization. Results obtained from density functional theory (DFT) calculations, protein structure-guided site-directed mutagenesis, isolation and structural characterization of the products generated by the mutants, and protein-ligand docking simulations suggested cyclization through bisabolyl-dunnienyl cations as the favored pathway, albeit the coexistence of a pathway through carotenyl cations is also possible. Y186 may play as a key residue to redirect water to trap the C7 carbocation and to promote the syn-protoetherification reaction.
abstract_zh: 在萜烯合酶（TS）催化的环化终止步骤中，为了消除碳正离子，除了通过质子消除生成烯烃产物和水淬灭生成羟基化产物外，分子内羟基捕获以生成萜烯醚是后一种情况的一种变体。在已知能直接将线性寡异戊烯基二磷酸转化为萜烯醚的有限TS中，1,8-桉叶素合酶是唯一被表征为在终止步骤中催化双键的syn-原醚化反应的酶。我们在此报道了一种源自细菌的倍半萜合酶AceS的发现及其机制研究，该酶以syn-原醚化方式将法尼基二磷酸转化为acorenol醚（1）。基于NMR分析和细胞色素P450修饰衍生物的X射线衍射（XRD），阐明了1中独特的5/6螺环稠合acorane骨架，其醚环桥接C3和C7。使用我们最近开发的“氘扫描”方法进行的标记实验，使我们能够表征从C10到C11的1,2-氢化物迁移和从C6到C10的氢化物迁移，以及环化过程中原醚化过程的syn-立体化学。密度泛函理论（DFT）计算、蛋白质结构指导的定点突变、突变体产物的分离与结构表征以及蛋白质-配体对接模拟结果表明，通过bisabolyl-dunnienyl阳离子的环化是优选途径，尽管通过carotenyl阳离子的途径也可能共存。Y186可能作为关键残基，用于引导水捕获C7碳正离子并促进syn-原醚化反应。
